statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail eases to 19% at the top of the low band as the energy and volatility amplifiers decay, while Stress stays high at 77% on a rate regime near 20-year highs.
recommendation: Mapped policy state is EA_ON for NQ_FUTURES and NAS100_CFD. Tail sits at the top of the low band: about 63% of the intraday range has been retraced, the session low has not been retested for hours, WTI is flat on the day and VIX has fallen further below its session high, so no persistent one-way structure is observed. Stress remains high because the drawdown backdrop of a 5.23% ten-year yield and near-$105 Brent is unresolved. One narrow danger window is flagged for 14:00-15:00Z on Sep 29, when JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence print together and the conditional forecast maps to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES.
headline: Nasdaq-100 goes sideways mid-range as the crude and volatility amplifiers keep decaying; Tail eases to the low band with Stress still high
body: As of the 18:00Z clock-hour the Nasdaq-100 trades at 30,334.47, down 273.67 points or 0.89%, after a gap-down open at 30,426.63 from Friday's 30,608.13 close. The session low of 30,081.06 was set hours ago and has not been retested; the index holds roughly 63% of the 30,081.06-30,480.40 intraday range back from that low and has been effectively flat over the past hour, so retracement is deep and repeated extension after failed pullbacks has not been observed. NQ futures trade 30,641.50, down 0.80%, about 284 points above their 30,357.75 low and near the midpoint of the 30,357.75-30,920.75 range. Both amplifiers continue to decay: WTI is $92.38, unchanged on the day against roughly 3% higher earlier in the session after Saudi East-West pipeline flows resumed, Brent is $105.13, up 0.78%, and VIX is 15.85, down from 16.02 an hour ago and well below its 16.62 session high despite being 6.6% up on the day. Rates are the unresolved stress source rather than a path-risk source: the ten-year yield is 5.23% against a 5.18% prior close and off its 5.27% high, the two-year is 4.93% about six basis points higher, and the thirty-year is reported near 5.57%, the highest since 2004. Internals stay dispersed rather than uniformly weak, with Nvidia higher after its board authorised a record $150 billion buyback increase against continued weakness in several other large semiconductors. Shared Finviz context collected at 14:34Z is both partial, with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, and older than the 90-minute freshness threshold at this assessment time; its latest-session breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections are explicitly non-real-time and were used only as weak background confirmation of broad sector weakness with high semiconductor dispersion, never as live price-path evidence. Taken together this reads as an orderly, dispersion-driven drawdown that is actively mean-reverting inside a high-yield regime with a spent energy impulse, which places Tail at 19% with Stress at 77% and Confidence at 88%.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours ran from a calm late-Friday regime with Tail near 8-14% into an overnight repricing that lifted Tail into the 21-24% watch band from the 03:00Z hour onward, while Stress climbed from 70% to the mid-80s. Two hours printed in the elevated band: 09:00Z at 26% during the European morning as crude extended, and 14:00Z at 27% as the US cash session traded down toward its low. The final three hours eased to 23%, 20% and 20% as the index recovered off the low and crude gave up its entire gain. Confidence improved steadily from 79% to 88% as live price-path and cross-asset evidence accumulated. Historical entries are the values published at the time and are not restated with later information.
outlookSummary: The conditional forecast keeps the watch band across the 19:00Z power hour and the 20:00Z cash close, which are the highest intraday slots because an unfilled gap-down day leaves little remaining time to mean-revert if a late second leg develops. After the close the path eases into the low band through the evening and Asian hours, on the explicit assumption that no fresh US-Iran or Strait of Hormuz headline arrives, while Stress stays high on the near-$105 Brent and 5.23% ten-year backdrop. The watch band returns from 09:00Z as European cash hours transmit the rate move, and the single elevated slot falls at 14:00Z on Sep 29, when JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence both print inside the first hour of US cash trade with the Dallas Fed Services Index following at 14:30Z. Forecast values are conditional risk, not an assertion that future price structure has been observed.
